O.content: The Wind bar extends higher on the page than the Solar, Hydroelectric, Biomass, and Geothermal bars.
A shared vertical axis is visibly drawn beside the bars with ticks labeled from 0 through 70.
The tallest bar is positioned above the label "Wind".

B.text: If bar height against the shared vertical axis encodes renewable-generation contribution, the tallest source bar is the largest contribution source; the task requires routing that source to its matching priority follow-up option.
B.conditions: Applies if the bar geometry is authoritative despite the conflicting percentage inscriptions.

O.content: The yellow bar above the x-axis label "Solar" has the printed inscription "41.2%" above it.
The light-blue bar above "Wind" has the printed inscription "29.8%" above it.
The blue bar above "Hydroelectric" has the printed inscription "18.5%" above it.
The green bar above "Biomass" has the printed inscription "7.2%" above it.
The brown bar above "Geothermal" has the printed inscription "3.3%" above it.

B.text: If each percentage inscription is attached to its source bar and denotes that source's renewable-generation contribution on a common comparable basis, the source with the greatest printed percentage is the largest contribution source; the task requires routing that source to its matching priority follow-up option.
B.conditions: Applies if the printed percentages, rather than bar heights, are the authoritative contribution encoding.
